title: Compare AI Agents in Real-World Scenarios
job_text: 1. Find a video comparing multiple AI agents in a real-world scenario. Extract the results and identify areas where each agent excels and struggles. 2. Summarize the findings in a table or chart, highlighting key strengths and weaknesses of each agent. 3. Note the hard limit: do not compare more than 3 AI agents.
what_happened: Eric recorded a video comparing the performance of Grok Bot, Hermes, and OpenClaw in a real-world scenario, highlighting areas where each excels and struggles.

evidence.note: Imported from a reply on the X thread tagged for @tryreallybot.
